name: Railtown AI Technologies Inc.
summary: Railtown AI Technologies Inc. provides specialized solutions through a software-as-a-service (SaaS) framework. The company's core product, Railtown AI, is an artificial intelligence-powered platform specifically designed to empower software developers by automatically identifying, tracking, overseeing, and alerting them to significant bugs and errors that arise during their development cycles. Founded in 2011, this Burnaby, Canada-based firm was previously known as Railtown Capital Corp. before officially rebranding to Railtown AI Technologies Inc. in August 2019.
